This repository contains both the original design for Google Material Icons (the “Work”, as defined in Section 1 of the Apache 2.0 License) and modifications made by the General Services Administration (GSA). This repository combines the Work and these GSA modifications, which is a “Modified Version” of Material Icons.

This repository also contains both original designs for Source Sans Pro, Merriweather, and Font Awesome (the “Font Software”, as defined in Section 1 of the SIL Open Font License, version 1.1) and modifications made by the General Services Administration (GSA). This repository combines the Work and these GSA modifications, which is a “Modified Version” of Source Sans Pro, Merriweather, Public Sans, and Font Awesome respectively.

As a work of the United States Government, the software modifications made by GSA are not subject to copyright within the United States. Additionally, GSA waives copyright and related rights in its software modifications worldwide through the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The Work (as defined in the Apache 2.0 License) and Font Software (as defined in the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1) remains subject to copyright under the respective open source license. The section below lists which works are subject to particular open source licenses.

This Modified Version packaged as `dist/img/sprite.svg` contains both design elements under the Apache 2.0 License and design modifications by GSA released as CC0. It is a “joint work” made of the icon set and modifications combined into a single work.

### Files licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1

The Source Sans Pro font files in `packages/uswds-core/src/assets/fonts/source-sans-pro` are a [customized subset](https://github.com/miguelsousa/source-sans-pro-subset) of [Source Sans Pro](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans-pro) owned by Adobe Systems Incorporated, licensed under the [SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/cms/scripts/page.php?site_id=nrsi&id=OFL_web), and copyright 2010, 2012, 2014 [Adobe Systems Incorporated], with Reserved Font Name 'Source'. The Merriweather font files in `packages/uswds-core/src/assets/fonts/merriweather` are the version 2.001 files from [GitHub](https://github.com/EbenSorkin/Merriweather/releases/tag/v2.001) subsetted into Latin and with additional formats generated with [Transfonter](https://transfonter.org/), licensed under the [SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/cms/scripts/page.php?site_id=nrsi&id=OFL_web), and copyright [Sorkin Type Co](https://github.com/SorkinType/Merriweather/blob/master/README.md) with Reserved Font Name 'Merriweather'.

Public Sans is a modification of Libre Franklin, also licensed under the [SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/cms/scripts/page.php?site_id=nrsi&id=OFL_web) by [Impallari Type](https://github.com/impallari/libre-franklin#license).

The Google Material Icons in `packages/usa-icon/src/img/material-icons-deprecated`, and those packaged as `dist/img/material-icons` are licensed under the [Apache License Version 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt).

principles.title: Start from user needs
principles.body:
Include real users early, test assumptions, and keep decisions grounded in what people need to accomplish.

Monet adaptation: U.S. Web Design System. [source-012](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/pages/design-principles/overview.md)

principles.title: Earn trust
principles.body:
Use reliable behavior, plain language and honest communication. Protect the time and information people entrust to the service.

Monet adaptation: U.S. Web Design System. [source-012](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/pages/design-principles/overview.md)

principles.title: Embrace accessibility
principles.body:
Design for varied abilities, devices and circumstances from the start. Evaluate the implemented service with people and assistive technology.

Monet adaptation: U.S. Web Design System. [source-012](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/pages/design-principles/overview.md)

principles.title: Promote continuity
principles.body:
Reuse familiar patterns across a service so people do not have to relearn its interaction at every step.

Monet adaptation: U.S. Web Design System. [source-012](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/pages/design-principles/overview.md)

principles.title: Listen and improve
principles.body:
Collect feedback throughout the life of the service and use it to improve the experience.

Monet adaptation: U.S. Web Design System. [source-012](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/pages/design-principles/overview.md)

foundations.guidance: Use the shadow-1 property recipe as mapped at a 16px reference root. The property table establishes the value; it does not decide which containers should receive a shadow or establish an application elevation hierarchy.

tokens.name: shadow.1
tokens.description: Monet adaptation: Resolve $system-properties box-shadow.standard.1: 0 units(1px) units(0.5) 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), using a 16px reference root. Keep the explicit 1px offset and express half an 8px grid unit as 0.25rem. No component elevation policy is inferred.

foundations.name: Layout
foundations.rationale: Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System for this preset configuration.
foundations.guidance: The default container maximum is the desktop breakpoint; the documented mobile and desktop column gaps are 2 and 4 units. Retain form/content widths appropriate to the task rather than filling every wide display.

tokens.name: layout.max-width
tokens.description: Monet adaptation: desktop breakpoint; theme-grid-container-max-width. Resolve the default desktop container token.

tokens.name: layout.gutter.mobile
tokens.description: Monet adaptation: theme-column-gap-mobile: 2. 2 USWDS spacing units.

tokens.name: layout.gutter.desktop
tokens.description: Monet adaptation: theme-column-gap-desktop: 4. 4 USWDS spacing units.

foundations.name: Borders and focus
foundations.description: Visible input boundaries and keyboard focus.
foundations.rationale: Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System for this preset configuration.
foundations.guidance: Use the input component boundary, keep labels visible, and retain the configured focus outline. The focus width is half a spacing unit; its actual contrast must be tested in the rendered component context.

tokens.name: border.focus-width
tokens.description: Monet adaptation: theme-focus-width: 0.5. Half-unit focus width resolved to 4px.

tokens.name: border.focus-offset
tokens.description: Upstream fact: theme-focus-offset: 0. Value from theme-focus-offset: 0; token name normalized for Monet.

components.rationale: Clear action labels and distinguishable interaction states.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System: Use standard buttons for a next step and outline buttons for actions on the same page. Lead concise labels with a verb. Distinguish default, hover and active states and show keyboard focus. Use native button/link semantics.

[source-024](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/button/guidance/usability.md) [source-025](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/button/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-026](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/button/guidance/when-to-use.md)
use_when: Submitting or acting on page content
avoid_when: A div or image used as a button

components.rationale: Visible labels with contextual guidance and errors.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System: Avoid placeholder text, including when a separate label exists: it disappears during entry and default rendering often has insufficient contrast. Keep necessary instructions visible. Use fields appropriate to the expected answer length and a text area for paragraphs. Show validation only after interaction. Preserve accessible labels and the form-control accessibility requirements.

[source-027](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/usability.md) [source-028](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-029](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/when-to-use.md)
use_when: Values that are not a fixed selection
avoid_when: Placeholder instructions inside a text field

components.rationale: Accessible comparison of genuinely tabular information.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System: Use a header row with short, plain-language labels, consistent units within each column, and appropriate scope or explicit header associations. Right-align numbers that represent amounts that can be totaled; phone numbers, ZIP codes and dates do not need that treatment. Put titles, attribution or update dates in a caption when supplied. For more than two columns, choose the documented scrollable or stacked small-screen variant.

[source-030](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/table/guidance/usability.md) [source-031](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/table/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-032](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/table/guidance/when-to-use.md)
avoid_when: Row sorting with mobile stacked variants

components.rationale: Task-relevant feedback with explicit status text.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System: Use informative, success, warning or error messages where they help the task. Explain the issue and next step. Do not rely on color alone; choose appropriate live-region behavior rather than announcing every message assertively.

[source-033](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/usability.md) [source-034](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-035](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/when-to-use.md)
use_when: A recoverable error with next steps

components.rationale: One or more selections from a visible set.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System: Provide clear labels and group related choices with a fieldset and legend. Preserve keyboard interaction and a visible focus state. Use radio buttons for a mutually exclusive choice; do not treat an unchecked checkbox as an ambiguous default.

[source-036](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/usability.md) [source-037](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-038](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/when-to-use.md)

patterns.title: Accessible form
patterns.summary: Keep labels, grouping and instructions attached to inputs.
patterns.body:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System guidance.

Use visible labels, fieldsets and legends for related choices, and instructions before they are needed. Identify required information and use the correct input semantics. Keep the action label clear. Test keyboard access and assistive-technology output after implementation.

Sources: [source-039](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_includes/forms-guidance.html) [source-027](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/usability.md) [source-028](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-029](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/when-to-use.md) [source-036](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/usability.md) [source-037](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-038](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/checkbox/guidance/when-to-use.md)

patterns.title: Form feedback
patterns.summary: Explain errors and provide a clear next step.
patterns.body:
Monet adaptation of U.S. Web Design System guidance.

Present actionable field feedback in context and use an alert for a task-wide message when appropriate. Do not encode success or error only through color. Keep the next action understandable and avoid repeated competing announcements.

Sources: [source-039](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_includes/forms-guidance.html) [source-033](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/usability.md) [source-034](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-035](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/alert/guidance/when-to-use.md) [source-027](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/usability.md) [source-028](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/accessibility.md) [source-029](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/blob/ffe2da7c59cf4e59881b1b0362a138440dd153ff/_components/text-input/guidance/when-to-use.md)
